description: Makes a professional quote (estimate) PDF for a small service business from the details the user gives: the business name, the customer, and each line item's name, quantity and price, plus an optional tax rate, discount, deposit, note and how many days the quote stays valid. EosLog adds up the subtotal, discount, tax and total, saves the quote behind an unguessable link for 90 days, and returns that link (view, download or email the PDF) and a direct PDF link. Use it when the user wants a quote or estimate to send a customer. It uses the user's prices and never sets them.

business_email.description: Business email to print on it.

business_name.description: The business sending the document, as it should print at the top.

business_phone.description: Business phone to print on it.

customer_name.description: Who the document is for, a person or a company. Printed as Customer when left out.

deposit_percent.description: Optional deposit to schedule the job, as a percent of the total.

discount_percent.description: Optional discount, as a percent off the subtotal.

line_items.description: One row per service or item, with the prices the user gives.

unit_price.description: Price per unit in US dollars.

tax_rate.description: Sales tax percent on the subtotal after any discount, for example 8.25. The user supplies it.

title.description: Optional subject line, for example Biweekly house cleaning.

valid_days.description: How many days the quote stays valid.

name: create_quote_pdf
title: Create a quote PDF
